messages:
emily: Observed a confusing case: saved per-route view for /api/generate shows quota estimate for model alias `prod-small` but after rollout the alias points to `prod-medium` and numbers don't match.

raj: Do you have the saved payload? Curious whether we saved alias only or canonical id too.

emily: snippet: filters: { route: "/api/generate", model: { pin: "prod-small" } } saved_at: 2025-07-10

tess: Sounds like alias repointing. UX-wise we shouldn't silently show metrics from a different underlying model. We need a banner when alias target changed.

design_kim: Banner copy suggestion: "Model alias 'prod-small' now resolves to 'prod-medium' — this view shows metrics from when it was saved. [Show live] [Use snapshot]"

raj: Proposal: saved_views store model_alias + optional model_canonical_id + snapshot{quota, cost, ts} at save time. On load: try resolve alias -> canonical_id within 700ms. If mismatch, surface banner and default to live if available.

emily: Also want telemetry: saved_view.open -> {alias_repointed: true/false, used_snapshot: true/false, resolve_latency_ms}.

infra-bot: Migration note: adding model_canonical_id and snapshot fields will touch ~12k rows. Suggest backfilled in small batches and feature-flag the UI behavior.

tess: One more: scheduled reports need deterministic numbers; add option in save dialog: Report policy = snapshot|live. Default: live for interactive, snapshot for scheduled.

design_kim: Will mock the banner + report-policy control and post Figma link.

emily: I'll draft RFC with schema change, migration, and telemetry. Volunteers?

raj: I'll own backend migration and alias resolve endpoint timing.

tess: I'll review RFC and own the UI toggle.

emily: Cool. We'll do a 48h 10% canary and watch saved_view.fallback_rate and resolve_latency_p95.
